description: List florists located in a US city from The Flowers Directory's city pages, with addresses, phone numbers when listed, and the date each listing was last verified. These are directory listings: an order placed through The Flowers Directory is made and delivered by a florist in the Florist One network, which may or may not be one of the listed shops.

zip.description: ZIP code; used to find the city when no city is given.

name: find_local_florists
title: Find local florists
